article.headline: Booth's 40 lead Samford past UNC Greensboro 87-78
article.description: — Jadin Booth scored a career-high 40 points and Samford beat UNC Greensboro 87-78 on Saturday.
article.linkText: Booth's 40 lead Samford past UNC Greensboro 87-78
article.story: BIRMINGHAM, Ala. -- — Jadin Booth scored a career-high 40 points and Samford beat UNC Greensboro 87-78 on Saturday. Booth had a big night from beyond the arc for the Bulldogs (18-13, 11-7 Southern Conference), as he connected on 11 of his 22 3-point attempts. Keaton Norris scored 10 points and added seven assists. Kam Martin finished 3 of 4 from the field to finish with nine points. Lilian Marville led the way for the Spartans (13-18, 9-9) with 21 points. Donald Whitehead Jr. added 14 points and two steals for UNC Greensboro. Valentino Pinedo also had 11 points, eight rebounds, two steals and two blocks. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
